boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Roger Williams University
boards.description: Current late-hours food stops on campus and around Bristol, with Newport options for a longer evening outing.

cards.title: Lower Commons
cards.subtitle: The Commons, lower level · RWU campus
cards.notes: Use the lower level of The Commons for a late campus food stop; check the dining page before going because schedules can change.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining with the latest listed regular hours.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU lists Lower Commons hours through 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 12:30 a.m. Friday, and midnight Saturday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Mon–Thu 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Fri until 12:30 a.m.; Sat–Sun until midnight. Confirm schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Just Baked kiosk
cards.subtitle: Center for Student Development · RWU campus
cards.notes: Locate the self-service kiosk in the Center for Student Development when other dining counters have closed; bring a payment method.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour campus kiosk for hot meals and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: RWU identifies the Just Baked kiosk in the Center for Student Development as offering convenient hot meals and snacks 24 hours a day.
cards.access_notes: RWU describes this kiosk as 24-hour; availability of individual items may vary.

cards.title: Classic Pizza & Grill
cards.subtitle: 349 Metacom Ave · Bristol
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or delivery order from Metacom Avenue when you need a Friday or Saturday food option after most local dinner service.
cards.short_summary: Bristol pizza and grill with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Classic Pizza & Grill lists Friday and Saturday hours until midnight and delivery service.
cards.access_notes: Listed Friday and Saturday hours are 11 a.m.–midnight; the business also states it delivers.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 11 Gooding Ave · Bristol
cards.notes: Use the Bristol store’s official ordering page to check pickup or delivery availability and place an order before its nightly cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizza pickup or delivery option listed to 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Bristol location page lists its Gooding Avenue store and current hours through 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location listing shows nightly service through 1 a.m.; verify the ordering page for the current pickup and delivery cutoff.

cards.title: Nikolas Pizza
cards.subtitle: 38 Memorial Blvd W · Newport
cards.notes: For a longer Newport run, use the restaurant’s order page and target Friday or Saturday, when its revised hours extend to midnight.
cards.short_summary: Newport pizza with midnight hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Nikolas Pizza lists revised Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–midnight at 38 Memorial Boulevard West in Newport.
cards.access_notes: Listed revised hours: Friday and Saturday until midnight; other listed days end earlier.

cards.title: The DeWolf Tavern
cards.subtitle: 259 Thames St · Bristol
cards.notes: Make a dinner plan for the Thames Street waterfront and use the restaurant’s contact details to confirm seating or takeout before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Bristol waterfront restaurant listed open nightly until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The DeWolf Tavern lists its Bristol address and daily operating hours through 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: Waterdog Kitchen + Bar
cards.subtitle: 125 Water St · Warren
cards.notes: Choose this Warren restaurant for an evening meal and confirm the kitchen cutoff, especially on Tuesday through Thursday when it closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: Warren dining option with service to 10 p.m. on select days.
cards.evidence_claim: Waterdog Kitchen + Bar lists Friday and Saturday hours until 10 p.m. and Tuesday–Thursday restaurant hours until 10 p.m., with an earlier kitchen close those days.
cards.access_notes: Listed: Tue–Thu 3–10 p.m. (kitchen closes 9 p.m.); Fri–Sat until 10 p.m.; Sunday until 9 p.m.

cards.title: The Mooring Seafood Kitchen & Bar
cards.subtitle: 1 Sayers Wharf · Newport
cards.notes: Reserve or call ahead for an evening Newport meal; the official site lists daily dinner availability until 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Waterfront Newport restaurant with daily 10 p.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mooring Seafood Kitchen & Bar lists its Newport address and daily hours of operation from 11:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists daily hours of 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; reservations and parking details are available on the site.

cards.title: Bar and Board Bistro
cards.subtitle: 282 Thames St · Newport
cards.notes: Use the reservation page for a Thames Street dinner; schedule around the listed 10 p.m. kitchen closing on Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Newport bistro whose kitchen is listed open until 10 p.m. most evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Bar and Board Bistro lists kitchen hours until 10 p.m. Tuesday through Saturday at 282 Thames Street in Newport.
cards.access_notes: Listed kitchen hours: Tue–Wed 4–10 p.m.; Thu–Sat noon–10 p.m.; Sunday until 9 p.m.

cards.title: Claw & Hammer
cards.subtitle: 527 Thames St · Newport
cards.notes: For a weekend Newport dinner, check the reservation page and arrive before the listed Friday–Saturday kitchen close at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Seafood restaurant with a 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday dinner close.
cards.evidence_claim: Claw & Hammer lists Friday and Saturday dinner hours from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m. at 527 Thames Street in Newport.
cards.access_notes: Listed Friday–Saturday dinner hours are 5–10 p.m.; weekday and Sunday dinner end earlier.
